name: Sanganeb Marine National Park and Dungonab Bay – Mukkawar Island Marine National Park
description: Two marine parks make up this Red Sea site off Sudan's coast. Sanganeb is the country's only atoll, a ring of coral rising from deep water 25 km offshore. Farther north, 125 km beyond Port Sudan, Dungonab Bay and Mukkawar Island combine reefs, mangroves, seagrass meadows and islets. Dugongs graze here, and sharks, turtles, manta rays and seabirds also thrive.
